support-ops: FYI escalation from ACME — embeddings dashboard shows a ~3x jump in 'units' yesterday, customer is seeing billing spike. They say numbers look like vectors + token-equivalent both being counted. Screenshot + sample payloads attached. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

kai: thanks — can you paste the raw telemetry payloads for one of the affected requests (request_id)? also which date range on the dashboard?

support-ops: range = 2026-03-15 00:00 - 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC. One sample payload we received from their client (copied from logs):

support-ops: ```json
{"request_id":"req_9a1b2c","client_id":"acme","model":"text-embedding-3a","timestamp":"2026-03-15T14:32:10Z","vectors":1,"vector_dims":1024,"tokens":1536,"unit_type":"vectors","units_calculated":1}
```

support-ops: And our ingestion event for the same request (from the realtime stream):

support-ops: ```json
{"request_id":"req_9a1b2c","source":"realtime","unit_type":"vectors","vector_count":1,"tokens":1536,"derived_units":3}  # derived_units = tokens/512 + vector_count (old logic)
```

marta: hmm — that derived_units looks suspicious. Did we recently change the telemetry schema? I vaguely recall a change that introduced a unified 'units' column while keeping legacy fields for backward compatibility.

eng-telemetry: confirmed — on 2026-03-14 we merged two ingestion transforms: one that maps legacy vector_count -> units and another that writes token_equivalent -> units. A downstream rollup mistakenly sums both fields when both are present instead of coalescing by request_id + unit_kind. Logs show both events (live and replay) for the same request_id.

eng-telemetry: sample stream log lines (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T14:32:10Z] event_in | req=req_9a1b2c src=client vectors=1 tokens=1536
[2026-03-15T14:32:11Z] event_in | req=req_9a1b2c src=replay vectors=null tokens=1536
[2026-03-15T14:32:11Z] transform | req=req_9a1b2c mapped_units_from_vectors=1 mapped_units_from_tokens=3
[2026-03-15T14:32:12Z] rollup   | req=req_9a1b2c sum_units=4
```

kai: so two issues: (1) schema/transform now populates both mapped_units_from_* fields when older and newer mappings coexist, and (2) cache/replay pipeline is replaying the same request without dedupe. That explains ~3-4x for customers who hit both code paths.

support-ops: customer notes the dashboard shows 'units' but the hover says "vectors" for some rows and "tokens" for others — confusing. They asked for a quick repro we can share.

kai: repro steps (short):
1) Send embed request to API with request_id=req_9a1b2c (or any unique id) and include tokens=1536 + vectors=1 in client metadata.
2) Wait for realtime ingestion to show units = tokens/512 + vector_count (pre-fix).
3) Trigger the nightly replay job for the same time window (or simulate by re-emitting the event) and observe dashboard double-sum.

marta: can we capture the exact SQL the dashboard uses to compute 'units'? That will help craft a hotfix query for customer-facing numbers.

eng-telemetry: dashboard rollup uses:```sql
SELECT client_id, date(trunc(ts)) as day, SUM(units) as total_units
FROM embeds_rollup_v1
WHERE day = '2026-03-15' AND client_id = 'acme'
GROUP BY client_id, day;
```
But embeds_rollup_v1 currently sums the 'units' column which, for some rows, was populated by mapping both vector_count and token_equiv into units during transform. There is no de-dup key enforced at rollup time.

tony: I can push a short-term hotfix: run a corrective aggregation to compute canonical_units per request_id using MAX priority (prefer vector_count when unit_type == 'vectors', else use ceil(tokens/512)). Example pseudo-query:```sql
WITH per_event AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         client_id,
         CASE
           WHEN vector_count IS NOT NULL THEN vector_count
           WHEN tokens IS NOT NULL THEN CEIL(tokens/512)
           ELSE 0
         END AS canonical_units
  FROM raw_embeds_events
  WHERE date(ts) = '2026-03-15' AND client_id = 'acme'
)
SELECT client_id, SUM(canonical_units) FROM per_event GROUP BY client_id;
```
This produces expected numbers and can be used to surface a corrected number in the dashboard temporarily.

marta: good. @tony please also disable the replay job for the affected 24h window until we confirm dedupe in the ingestion transform. We should inform the customer that we are doing a corrected rollup and will follow up with a permanent fix + root cause.

tony: will do. I'll also add a guard in the transform to coalesce by request_id (prefer latest non-null unit source) and make rollups idempotent by grouping by request_id before summing. Rolling patch now, ETA ~2h.

support-ops: prepping a message to the customer. Draft: "We're investigating why your embeddings units appear inflated. Early findings: two telemetry sources (live + replay) and a schema mapping overlap caused duplication. We're running a corrected rollup and will share the adjusted usage within 3 hours. Temporary mitigation: we've paused the nightly replay for the impacted window." Thoughts?

kai: looks good, be explicit about corrected numbers and offer to credit if billing impact is confirmed.

marta: add "we will follow up with permanent fix and timeline". Also add a small note in the dashboard (admin banner) to avoid more escalations.

support-bot: :ticket: Created support ticket #INC-2026-451 for ACME escalation and linked to this thread.

support-ops: thanks everyone — I'll send the customer update and keep this thread updated when the rollup completes. :white_check_mark:
